Animation Video Skill — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release: Instantly create animated videos from scripts or images with cloud AI processing.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, PNG, JPG) and returns 1080p MP4 exports in 1–3 minutes.
- Automated free token handling and session management for easy setup.
- Clear user workflows for uploading, editing, exporting, and managing credits.
- Error codes and intelligent guidance for smoother editing and animation creation.
